items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: there was a short period Benny Golson worked, and a short period Philly Joe Jones played drums.

ctx.x: He didn't have an organ player during that period?

No, there was no organ. But we had periods where... there was a short period Benny Golson worked, and a short period Philly Joe Jones played drums. Who else came in and out of the band, just short periods where they did a segment of the thing? Papa Jo Jones played some, a couple of gigs.

But it kept me in company like I'd never dreamed of being in before, plus the opportunities when, say, we'd go to New York. We went to New York and we were working at the Band Box, right next door to Birdland, and guys would come in and play the first set, because the first set was just an instrumental thing. Hamp would have the thing set up that the band would go out and play a few tunes and he wouldn't come out on the first hour. Then we'd have a break and come back and Hamp would be there, when he'd bring on…
